nodes.label: Detector Backend Catalog
nodes.rationale: One config node enumerates every supported inference backend (cpu, deepstack, degirum, edgetpu, hailo8l, memryx, onnx, openvino, rknn, synaptics, teflon_tfl, tensorrt, zmq, axengine) so hardware choice is a config value rather than a build variant.

nodes.label: Semantic Search Configuration
nodes.rationale: Semantic search is gated on downloading vision and text embedding models and on a reindex pass, so it ships disabled and exposes model/model_size/device knobs to trade accuracy against limited NVR hardware.

nodes.label: Generative AI Provider Configuration
nodes.rationale: GenAI is configured as a pluggable provider (api_key, base_url, model, provider, roles, provider_options, runtime_options) so descriptions, review summaries and chat can be routed to local or hosted LLMs without code changes.

nodes.label: Authentication Configuration
nodes.rationale: Auth exposes failed_login_rate_limit, hash_iterations, session_length, trusted_proxies and admin_first_time_login so a locally hosted NVR can be hardened or fronted by a reverse proxy without an external identity provider.
